description: Land Title Settlement Department - Hambantota and Indiwinna, Hambantota D/S Division, Hambantota District - Cad. Map No. 830114
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land ownership determinations for specific parcels of land in Hambantota, including details of land parcel numbers, extent, owners' names, and title classifications. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land property matters, fitting the definition of Land Gazettes (Type 4) which cover land registrations, property ownership, and land title settlements.
